trigger: kind=processes on a device whose output exceeds 64 KiB; a poll lands between RUNNING chunks, or a chunk boundary falls between rows
summary: reduce_rows answered ok on any non-empty output (a partial list served as complete) and joined chunks with no separator so the last row of one chunk fused with the first of the next. Also found independently by quality-engineer as QE-1. The fusion half is introduced; the partial half was pre-existing but newly claimed as 'read whole'.

Closed by 27d2ca5fd3 (poll engine): an answer needs a row with status >= 1 (both ingest shapes tested), chunks join with a newline, no terminal row ends as incomplete (504), rows order by id. Re-reviewed clean at Gate 8.

trigger: SIGTERM during a 40x500 ms live poll (REST and MCP; deterministic for agentic callers)
summary: The poll never consulted the stream budget closing flag and the shutdown drain did not count kLiveRead leases, so stop() waited the 15 s web wait then took std::_Exit(1), skipping OffloadTargetStore::flush_all (I2 only for targets with batch_size > 1). Adjudicated by unhappy-path and sre: I2 applies narrowly; the live poll broke the existing shutdown contract (every other 15 s+ handler is close-signalled or drain-counted).

Closed by 72e10c3bbf (handlers, shutdown, gate_unreadable): admit_live_read refuses while draining on REST, MCP and the quarantine confirm; the drain counts kLiveRead within the 30 s cap; should_stop reads closing() not draining_fn_. Arithmetic re-verified by cpp-safety and sre at Gate 8 (a live poll cannot reach _Exit; the drain cannot wedge). Re-reviewed clean at Gate 8.

trigger: an rbac, session or auth store degrades between the first scoped gate and the second (#7110) decision
summary: The re-decision reported a store degrade as a revocation: MCP answered permission denied 'withdrawn, ask an administrator' with a permission_revoked failure row, and REST kept the 503 but labelled the failure row and metric permission_revoked. False audit evidence. Found independently by compliance-officer as CO-2.

Closed by 72e10c3bbf (handlers, shutdown, gate_unreadable): a typed ScopedGateOutcome: Denied is permission_revoked, Unauthenticated is caller_unresolved, Unavailable and both degraded classes are gate_unreadable (retryable); REST restates a retryable 503; tests on both surfaces for every class. A4 (round 1) additionally fails the MCP path closed when the typed gate is unwired. Re-reviewed clean at Gate 8.

trigger: an MCP client auto-approves on readOnlyHint or blind-retries on idempotentHint
summary: get_device_live was served readOnlyHint:true and idempotentHint:true although each call dispatches a command to the device (hashing every executable), writes 2-3 audit rows and persists the result for the retention period. Compliance-officer raised the same (CO-4). The earlier owner ruling had marked the tool idempotent.

Closed by a1f7b2fc1f (label override) and 95ffcc267c (round-1 code): owner ruling 2026-11-24 (questions window, option 'add a label override'): the closed kDispatchProbeTools table serves readOnly false, idempotent false, destructive false, openWorld false; the security row, tier gate, check order and callers are unchanged; the table is pinned by exact content in test_mcp_server.cpp and recorded in A5. This reverses the earlier idempotent ruling at the owner's direction. Re-reviewed clean at Gate 8.

trigger: an operator or customer automation reads upgrading.md before upgrading
summary: The breaking section omitted the 504 to 503 store-degrade status change and misstated the 'before' behaviour of multi-row answers. Extended by enterprise-readiness as ER-1 (4 MiB refusal 200 to 502, global held-open capacity, gauge meaning, fixed per-process limits). I7 raised to HIGH because it conceals a breaking change.

Closed by c05d079048 (docs), 17862e9de2 (round-1 docs) and 9ad2654d3b (final): all rows added, the 'before' cell corrected, restart/fresh-deployment sentences, 64-stored-row refusal and the undetectable-chunk limit stated; re-read end to end by enterprise-readiness at Gate 8 round 2. Re-reviewed clean at Gate 8.

summary: Retention and privacy disclosure was false or absent: mcp.md said the hints hold because the call 'changes nothing the server stores' and the DEX guide table said 'Nothing stored', while the poll reads rows persisted in response_store for response_retention_days (default 90); the SOC 2 erasure-source list omitted device.live.processes.

Closed by c05d079048 (docs) and 17862e9de2 (round-1 docs): false sentences removed everywhere (a repo grep is clean), retention and personal-data handling stated in mcp.md, rest-api.md, the tool description, the SOC 2 doc (erasure list now five categories) and the served DEX guide. Re-reviewed clean at Gate 8.

trigger: one request carrying two credentials for different principals where the first-resolved credential lapses between the two resolutions
summary: The REST live route bound its audit rows to the first resolved session but dispatched as the second resolution; the MCP twin refused a principal change and REST did not. Derived HIGH mechanically (I1 base HIGH, E5 no change); no authorization bypass because the gates re-decide as the dispatched principal.

Closed by 95ffcc267c (round-1 code) and 9ad2654d3b (final): REST compares the second resolution with the first, answers 401 and writes a caller_unresolved failure row under the original session naming the second principal through audit_token, and dispatches nothing; tests include a hostile second principal; happy-path and unhappy-path traced every ordinary configuration and found no false 401. Re-reviewed clean at Gate 8.

trigger: a failed store of one middle chunk of a multi-chunk answer
summary: The tool description and docs said partial output is never returned; the dropped-middle-chunk limit (UP-4) was disclosed only in rest-api.md, mcp.md and the ADR, but A5 item 2(c) wants it in the description. Derived HIGH via I3 although the underlying defect is owner-accepted.

Closed by 95ffcc267c (round-1 code) and 9ad2654d3b (final): the description and docs now say partial output without a final row is never returned, a chunk the server failed to store cannot be detected, and an answer over the size cap is cut and flagged truncated at once. Re-reviewed clean at Gate 8.

trigger: a PG blip or pool timeout at the terminal frame so finalize_terminal_status errors
summary: A FAILURE terminal that never lands left status-0 rows, so the poll answered ok with failed-command output (false success). Pre-existing ingest property, newly claimed by the poll's 'read whole'.
Closed by 27d2ca5fd3 (poll engine): an answer now requires a row with status >= 1, so a lost terminal write ends as incomplete (504), never a false success. Re-reviewed clean at Gate 8.

trigger: a device success terminal with no output or unparseable lines
summary: An empty or unusable result (processes with zero rows, uptime with neither field) was served as a 200 or MCP success: zero processes on a live endpoint is never true.

Closed by 27d2ca5fd3 (poll engine) and 72e10c3bbf (handlers, shutdown, gate_unreadable): LiveResultJson::empty maps to outcome device_error (REST 502, MCP internal error) on both surfaces; N2 (round 1) keeps a cut-to-nothing answer as success with truncated and count 0. Re-reviewed clean at Gate 8.

trigger: server clock step back, replica skew or many chunks within one second
summary: Rows were ordered by (timestamp seconds, id); a clock step scrambles chunks and compounds fusion.
Closed by 27d2ca5fd3 (poll engine): rows order by id alone (BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY, verified) and the read uses query_bounded with an id tiebreak. Re-reviewed clean at Gate 8.
